review.tagline: Cross-platform desktop chat client for many cloud and local LLM providers
review.summary: Cherry Studio is a desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux that talks to cloud providers such as OpenAI, Gemini and Anthropic, and to local models through Ollama and LM Studio. It includes 300+ preset assistants, simultaneous multi-model chats, document handling (text, images, Office, PDF), WebDAV backup and an MCP server integration. An Enterprise Edition with admin backend and shared knowledge bases is sold separately.
review.audience: Individuals wanting one desktop client for many LLM providers and local models
strengths: Supports cloud providers plus local Ollama and LM Studio in one client
Runs the same prompt against multiple models in a single conversation
Installs as a desktop app with no environment setup, on Windows, Mac and Linux
300+ preconfigured assistants plus custom assistant creation
weaknesses: AGPL-3.0; commercial use outside AGPL terms needs a separate license
Admin backend, team knowledge base and access control are Enterprise-only
Plugin system, OCR, TTS and ASR are listed as roadmap items, not shipped
No Docker or web deployment; desktop only, so no multi-user server in Community Edition
needs: Needs Ollama or LM Studio (optional, for local models), WebDAV (optional, for backup)
Models: OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic, Ollama, LM Studio
